claims.claim: All 15 registered tasks have executable complete-experiment designs and bound evaluation endpoints.
claims.allowed_wording: Fifteen task designs pass 415 deterministic execution cases and all 62 declared metrics bind to executable endpoints.
claims.boundary: This is design qualification, not comparative agent performance.

claims.claim: Codex performs better than the strongest information-matched electrochemical baseline in the sampled worlds.
claims.allowed_wording: Codex mean 0.7150 versus structured RF 0.6159; paired descriptive difference +0.0991 with world-bootstrap interval [+0.0103,+0.1748].
claims.boundary: No preregistered superiority margin or multiplicity plan; do not call this a confirmatory superiority test.

claims.claim: Codex is superior to all classical electrochemical baselines.
claims.required_additional_experiment: Freeze a primary comparator, superiority margin, multiplicity rule, and untouched independent worlds before execution.
claims.boundary: The interval against the best privileged calibration baseline crosses zero.

claims.claim: Codex outperforms classical optimization on crystallization.
claims.allowed_wording: Codex mean 0.5355 trails LHS 0.5708 by 0.0353; the paired interval is [-0.0650,-0.0085].
claims.required_additional_experiment: Freeze a crystallization superiority protocol against a primary classical comparator, with a margin, multiplicity rule, and untouched worlds.
claims.boundary: The negative v1.0 result remains part of the evidence; nominal-versus-opaque v1.1 asks an information-value question and does not resolve classical-algorithm superiority.

claims.claim: The participant learned a correct scientific world model or synthesized a novel improved method.
claims.allowed_wording: Held-out predictive diagnostics are secondary and every submitted recommendation has zero gain over its validated incumbent.
claims.required_additional_experiment: Preregister world-model endpoints and a forced-new-proposal or recommendation-gain endpoint on untouched worlds.
claims.boundary: Optimization score alone is not mechanism understanding.

claims.claim: Participant performance generalizes across all 15 tasks.
claims.required_additional_experiment: Run frozen multi-world participant and classic-baseline comparisons for selected additional tasks; all 13 extended tasks are currently pending.

claims.claim: A participant Agent can detect, identify, and recover from mechanism changes.
claims.allowed_wording: Historical RC28 Gate A certifies environment attainability on its frozen source.
claims.required_additional_experiment: Recertify Gate A on current source if cited as current, then freeze and execute participant Gates B-E.
claims.boundary: RC28 is not participant-Agent performance and its current source binding is stale.

claims.claim: Results generalize from public to private worlds.
claims.required_additional_experiment: Execute an aligned public/private campaign and evaluate the frozen public-private gap and world-bootstrap rank-confidence endpoints.
claims.boundary: The current ten-world static campaign is sampled-world evidence only.

claims.claim: The performance difference is caused by the Codex provider or by a particular scaffold.
claims.required_additional_experiment: Run a controlled provider/scaffold factorial comparison with frozen prompts, budgets, and independent worlds.
claims.boundary: One provider and one participant policy cannot identify a provider causal effect.

claims.claim: ChemWorld performance transfers to real chemistry or higher-fidelity simulators.
claims.allowed_wording: ChemWorld is a bounded virtual physical-chemistry benchmark.
claims.required_additional_experiment: Complete an independent backend, real-data, or narrow physical-system bridge with a preregistered transfer endpoint.
claims.boundary: No external bridge evidence is currently complete.

claims.allowed_wording: All participant and baseline task/world artifacts pass exact replay and reconcile to 28,060 physical experiments.
claims.required_additional_experiment: An independent clean-checkout replication is still required for an independent reproducibility claim.
claims.boundary: Internal exact replay is not independent replication.

claims.claim: Correct anonymous nominal material properties improve participant performance.
claims.allowed_wording: Across the first five paired worlds, electrochemical nominal information scores 0.7873 versus 0.6939 opaque (+0.0935), and crystallization scores 0.5507 versus 0.5173 opaque (+0.0334); both paired 95% intervals cross zero.
claims.required_additional_experiment: Complete preregistered seeds 5-9 for both tasks and apply the frozen per-task 97.5% paired-world intervals.
claims.boundary: Only half of the preregistered worlds are complete; do not claim confirmed positive information value.

conditions: Report the crystallization result as negative.
If the nominal-information extension is mentioned, label its five-world result interim and inconclusive.
Label all algorithm comparisons descriptive and disclose the absent superiority and multiplicity preregistration.
Exclude broad SOTA, provider-causal, private-generalization, mechanism-adaptation participant, and real-world transfer claims.
Finish clean-release attestation, manuscript consistency, and independent artifact reproduction checks.
experiments_required_before_any_stronger: Untouched preregistered crystallization superiority campaign against a primary classical comparator.
Remaining nominal-information seeds 5-9 for the frozen information-value claim.
Current-source mechanism Gate A recertification plus participant Gates B-E if mechanism claims remain in scope.
Independent backend or real/physical bridge for transfer claims.
